activation_baseline.basis: Elaren Kestrel v677-v2 immutable repository seal plus its one-row post-final route overlay, kept as separately attributable layers.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The initial memory-summary size projection piped a PowerShell if/else expression directly and failed with an empty-pipe parse error before reading or changing repository state.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A scalar assignment before JSON projection recovered the bounded memory lookup without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first activation-packet lines 101-200 display clipped part of a long flashcard line and earned zero full-window credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Separate 101-150 and 151-200 windows recovered the unchanged packet bytes through that interval.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first all-window activation-packet display exceeded the global presentation budget and was incomplete.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded 25-line windows completed the exact 496-line packet through EOF without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first full current-state.json projection exceeded its output budget before EOF.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Four bounded windows completed all 1,556 lines and preserved the mutable snapshot read-only.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad activation-packet rg projection expanded repeated flashcard prose and exceeded its output budget.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Exact headings and bounded packet sections supplied the required route and lifecycle fields without repeating the broad projection.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined parallel manifest replay exceeded the model-context presentation boundary and produced no attributable complete aggregate.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Serial scalar-only Git-blob replays established all four manifest digests and the content seal without invoking the predecessor canonical.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first PowerShell manifest wrapper was rejected by the command policy before execution.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A read-only Python Git-object projection used literal paths and emitted bounded scalar results.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first isolated replay used a nonexistent manifests directory and raised FileNotFoundError before any Git-object comparison.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A literal rg file listing resolved the validation directory and the replay then used the exact committed filenames.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: Parallel byte-and-digest replay reported inconsistent checkout-byte mismatches for CRLF YAML projections.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Serial replay distinguished raw checkout byte counts from normalized-LF Git-blob digests and established zero digest mismatches.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A broad D-drive receipt-name scan remained unbounded past ninety seconds and was cancelled with zero receipt credit.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: A bounded search of the named canonical and validation receipt banks located the exact predecessor latch and receipt.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A depth-two D-drive directory projection expanded thousands of paths and exceeded its presentation budget.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The top-level receipt-bank names already exposed by the bounded prefix were used for exact bank-scoped searches only.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first broad prior-Neris Git-tree projection crossed its command-yield boundary without returning a bounded file list.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Exact docs, scripts, and tests pathspecs recovered only the declared prior-owner templates without mutating them.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first source-bounded semantic audit found one exact inherited title and ten additional titles at or above the preregistered 0.75 token-Jaccard quarantine ceiling, then failed closed before writing x1 documents.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The bounded collision report identified only the eleven affected proposal IDs; those titles were rewritten while every noncolliding proposal and the immutable source remained unchanged.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first x1 test invocation ran before staged-manifest assembly: nine tests passed and the manifest-coverage test failed because the four owner code paths were not yet recorded.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact declared x1 set was staged, the manifest assembler captured the four code paths, and only the failed manifest-coverage test was selected for dependency recovery; the nine prior passes were not replayed.
